name: Design Churn Interventions
summary: Diagnose voluntary and payment churn, then design respectful interventions with guardrails.
description: Design retention interventions across cancellation, failed-payment recovery, pause, downgrade, support, and win-back paths. Use when a subscription business needs to diagnose churn mechanisms and test remedies without obstructing cancellation.
risk_reason: This skill diagnoses voluntary and payment churn, then design respectful interventions with guardrails; it does not contact users without valid consent or continue after an opt-out.
refuses: It does not hide cancellation, add deceptive friction, shame users, or manufacture urgency.
It does not contact users without valid consent or continue after an opt-out.
It does not describe delayed cancellation or trapped customers as retention success.

operational.latency_reason: The skill diagnoses voluntary and payment churn, then design respectful interventions with guardrails, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
